# ToolScout

> ToolScout is a directory that helps you discover, compare and choose the best AI tools for writing, images, video, coding, productivity, marketing, chatbots and audio.

ToolScout is an independently researched directory of AI tools, organized by category, with comprehensive reviews covering pricing, features, pros and cons, and real user sentiment sourced from G2, Capterra and Reddit. Every tool page includes a quick-facts summary, detailed feature breakdown, full pricing tiers, and an FAQ section.

## Categories

- [Writing & Content](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/writing-content.html): Draft, edit and scale blog posts, ads and marketing copy with AI.
- [Image Generation](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/image-generation.html): Turn text prompts into original art, product shots and illustrations.
- [Video Generation](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/video-generation.html): Create video, avatars and B-roll from text or a script.
- [Coding & Development](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/coding-development.html): Pair-program, autocomplete and ship code faster with AI.
- [Productivity & Automation](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/productivity-automation.html): Automate busywork and organize your work with AI.
- [Marketing & SEO](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/marketing-seo.html): Research keywords, optimize content and track rankings with AI.
- [Chatbots & Assistants](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/chatbots-assistants.html): General-purpose AI assistants for research, writing and everyday questions.
- [Audio & Voice](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/audio-voice.html): Generate voiceovers, clone voices and edit audio with AI.
- [AEO Tools](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/aeo-tools.html): Track and improve how your brand appears in ChatGPT, Perplexity and other AI answers.

## Tools

### Writing & Content
- [Jasper](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/jasper.html): AI content platform built for marketing teams — Pro from $59/mo per seat (billed yearly); Business custom-priced. No free plan.
- [Copy.ai](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/copy-ai.html): AI copywriting and GTM workflow automation — Free tier available; Chat plan from $24/mo (billed annually); Growth/Enterprise plans from $1,000/mo+
- [Grammarly](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/grammarly.html): AI writing assistant for grammar, tone and clarity — Free tier available; Pro from $12/mo (billed annually; $30/mo billed monthly)
- [Writesonic](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/writesonic.html): AI Search Visibility (GEO) platform with SEO content tools — 7-day free trial, no credit card required; plans from $79/mo billed annually
- [SummarizingTool](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/summarizingtool.html): AI summaries for text, documents, and video — plus rewriting, paraphrasing, and AI detection — Free tier available; Monthly plan from $4.99/mo
- [GoZen Content AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/gozen-content-ai.html): AI writing and image generation for SEO blogs, social posts, and ads — Free tier (2,000 AI words + 10 AI images/mo); paid plans start around $9/mo

### Image Generation
- [Midjourney](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/midjourney.html): AI art generator known for painterly, high-detail images — From $10/mo (Basic); no free trial; annual billing saves 20%
- [DALL-E 3](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/dall-e-3.html): OpenAI's retired image generator, formerly built into ChatGPT — Retired May 12, 2026; was included with ChatGPT Plus ($20/mo) or ~$0.04-0.08/image via API — succeeded by GPT Image 2
- [Adobe Firefly](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/adobe-firefly.html): Commercially safe AI image generation inside Adobe apps — Free tier available; paid plans from $9.99/mo (Standard)
- [Ideogram](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/ideogram.html): AI image generator with strong text-in-image rendering — Free tier available; paid plans from $20/mo (Plus)
- [ImgGen AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/imggen-ai.html): Free, watermark-free AI text-to-image generator with 120+ styles — Free (50 one-time credits, no card); Starter $9.99/mo (400 credits/mo); Pro $29.99/mo (1,400 credits/mo); custom Enterprise
- [Stable Fast 3D](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/stable-fast-3d.html): Single image to a UV-unwrapped 3D mesh in about half a second — Free for non-commercial use and commercial use up to $1M annual revenue (Stability AI Community License); Enterprise License required above that threshold; also usable via paid Stability AI Platform API credits
- [Modelia](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/modelia.html): AI fashion model generator for e-commerce product photography — Free Starter tier (20 credits/mo, watermarked); Project $12 one-time (50 credits); Basic $35/mo; Pro $85/mo; Business $300/mo — 20% off with annual billing

### Video Generation
- [Runway](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/runway.html): Generative video and editing suite for creators — Free tier (125 one-time credits); paid plans from $12/mo billed yearly ($15/mo monthly)
- [Synthesia](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/synthesia.html): AI avatar videos for training and corporate content — Free tier (10 min/mo, watermarked); Starter from $18/mo billed yearly ($29/mo monthly)
- [HeyGen](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/heygen.html): AI avatar and localization tool for marketing video — Free tier (3 videos/mo, 1 min each); paid plans from $29/mo (Creator, billed monthly)
- [Kling AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/kling-ai.html): AI video generator known for realistic motion — Free tier (daily credit allowance); paid plans from ~$10/mo (Standard) — pricing changes frequently, verify at checkout
- [Shai](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/shai.html): AI pre-production for film and advertising — script to storyboard in seconds — Not publicly disclosed; platform access is currently via waitlist/early access, no self-serve pricing page
- [RepliQ](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/repliq.html): Personalized video, image, and text outreach at scale — Free plan with 30 videos; Monthly plan from $39/mo (200 personalized videos/images/sentences); Annual plan from $19/mo billed annually

### Coding & Development
- [GitHub Copilot](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/github-copilot.html): AI pair programmer built into major IDEs — Free tier available (2,000 completions/mo); Pro $10/mo, Pro+ $39/mo, Business $19/user/mo
- [Cursor](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/cursor.html): AI-first code editor built for agentic coding — Free tier (Hobby) available; Pro $20/mo, Pro+ $60/mo, Ultra $200/mo, Teams $40/user/mo
- [Claude Code](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/claude-code.html): Anthropic's agentic coding tool for the terminal — Included with Claude Pro ($17-20/mo), Max ($100-200/mo), Team Premium and Enterprise plans; usage-based API pricing also available
- [Replit AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/replit-ai.html): AI app builder inside a browser-based dev environment — Free (Starter) tier available; Core plan $20/mo billed annually ($25/mo monthly)
- [Sofy](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/sofy.html): AI testing agents that write, run, and fix tests across mobile, web, API, and enterprise apps — AI Agent plans from $49/mo (100 tests/mo); Pro $249/mo (500 tests/mo); Enterprise custom. Separate real-device testing plans (Automate/Live) start at $749/mo billed annually
- [Factory](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/factory.html): Agent-native software development — autonomous Droids for the full SDLC — Pro $20/mo; Plus $100/mo; Max $200/mo; Business and Enterprise are custom, contact-sales only
- [Zeedle AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/zeedle-ai.html): AI agents that generate, test, and optimize your code end-to-end — Free Starter tier (100 AI code-generation requests/mo, 1 project); Pro $19/mo (1,000 requests/mo, 10 projects); Enterprise custom. All paid plans include a 14-day free trial, no credit card required

### Productivity & Automation
- [Notion AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/notion-ai.html): AI writing, Q&A and agent built into your Notion workspace — Free plan available; paid plans from $10/mo per seat (Plus); full Notion AI bundled into Business at $20/mo per seat
- [Zapier](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/zapier.html): No-code automation connecting thousands of apps — Free plan (100 tasks/mo); paid plans from $19.99/mo (Professional, 750 tasks); Team from $69/mo; Enterprise custom
- [Motion](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/motion.html): AI calendar and task planner — Individual plans from $19/seat/mo (Pro AI, billed annually) or $29/seat/mo (Business AI); no free plan
- [ClickUp AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/clickup-ai.html): AI features layered on a project management platform — Free tier available; ClickUp Brain AI add-on from $9/seat/mo (annual) on top of a paid plan; Everything AI tier at $28/seat/mo
- [Microsoft Translator](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/microsoft-translator.html): Microsoft's free-to-enterprise machine translation service for text, speech, and documents. — Free consumer apps and free Azure tier (2M characters/month); paid Azure tiers billed per million characters; on-premises enterprise edition from ~$310,000/year
- [Ishi](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/ishi.html): The on-device architect that bridges local files to your cloud AI agents. — Free tier (BYOK); one-time lifetime Pro license $49 during public beta (list price $99) — no subscription

### Marketing & SEO
- [Surfer SEO](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/surfer-seo.html): AI-guided on-page content optimization — From $49/mo (Discovery), billed annually — plans up to $299/mo, Enterprise custom
- [HubSpot AI Tools](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/hubspot-ai-tools.html): AI features (Breeze) across HubSpot's marketing and CRM suite — Free CRM tier; Starter from ~$15-20/mo per seat, Pro/Enterprise scale into hundreds-thousands/mo
- [Semrush](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/semrush.html): All-in-one SEO, competitive research and AI-search platform — No full free plan (limited free account only); paid plans from $139.95/mo, or $117.33/mo billed annually
- [Otterly AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/otterly-ai.html): Tracks how brands appear in AI search answers — Plans from $29/mo (Lite), or $25/mo billed annually
- [PilotScribe](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/pilotscribe.html): Your SEO, on autopilot — keyword research, writing, publishing, and rewriting, unattended. — Starter $39/mo; Pro $99/mo (most popular); Agency $299/mo — billed monthly, cancel anytime
- [Lovart](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/lovart.html): The AI design agent that turns a brief into a complete, on-brand campaign. — Free tier with daily credits; paid plans roughly $16-$109/month billed annually (Starter/Basic/Pro/Ultimate), higher on monthly billing
- [SmartlyQ](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/smartlyq.html): The all-in-one AI marketing platform for content, social, chatbots, and publishing automation. — Pro from €97/month; Business €297/month; Enterprise €497/month (or custom); 20% off on annual billing; 30-day money-back guarantee

### Chatbots & Assistants
- [ChatGPT](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/chatgpt.html): OpenAI's general-purpose AI assistant — Free tier available; Go from $8/mo, Plus from $20/mo, Pro from $200/mo
- [Claude](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/claude.html): Anthropic's AI assistant, known for careful, high-quality writing — Free tier available; Pro from $20/mo
- [Perplexity](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/perplexity.html): AI answer engine with real-time, cited web search — Free tier available; Pro from $20/mo, Max at $200/mo
- [Google Gemini](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/google-gemini.html): Google's AI assistant integrated across Workspace — Free tier available; AI Pro from $19.99/mo (AI Plus from $4.99/mo)
- [Dapta AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/dapta-ai.html): All-in-one AI voice and text agents built for SMB sales automation — Free tier (2K credits); paid plans from $99/mo, up to $1,499/mo for enterprise-scale credits and support
- [Leadster](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/leadster.html): The conversational marketing chatbot built to turn website traffic into qualified leads. — Plans from $47/month up to $1,000/month; free tier with limited functionality; 14-day free trial on paid plans
- [NewMode (Algomo)](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/newmode-algomo.html): Turns anonymous website traffic into identified, qualified sales pipeline. — Plans start at $200/month (Growth tier); custom Enterprise pricing; no per-seat pricing; contact sales for a demo

### Audio & Voice
- [ElevenLabs](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/elevenlabs.html): Widely used AI voice generation and cloning platform — Free tier (10k credits/mo, no commercial rights); Starter from $6/mo ($5/mo billed yearly)
- [Descript](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/descript.html): Edit audio and video by editing a text transcript — Free tier available; Hobbyist from $16/mo (billed yearly), Creator (most popular) from $24/mo (billed yearly)
- [Murf AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/murf-ai.html): AI voiceover studio for presentations and e-learning — Free plan (no credit card, 10 min voice generation, no commercial rights); paid plans from $19/mo billed yearly ($29/mo billed monthly)
- [WellSaid Labs](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/wellsaid-labs.html): Enterprise-grade AI voices for brand-consistent audio — Free trial available; Starter from $10/mo billed yearly ($19/mo billed monthly)
- [AI Phone](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/ai-phone.html): Real-time AI call translator that lets you speak your language while they hear theirs. — Free to start; in-app subscription/credit-based paid plans on iOS and Android (exact tier pricing set via App Store/Google Play)
- [MIDI Agent](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/midi-agent.html): The AI MIDI generator plugin that turns text prompts into editable notes inside your DAW. — $49 lifetime license (50% off regular $99); optional MIDI Agent Pro subscription at $20/month for managed AI access

### AEO Tools
- [Profound](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/profound.html): Enterprise-grade analytics for AI search visibility — No free tier; plans from $99/mo (Starter, ChatGPT-only) to $399/mo (Growth, 3 engines); custom Enterprise pricing
- [Scrunch AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/scrunch-ai.html): AI visibility monitoring plus hallucination detection — No free tier; 7-day free trial; plans from $250/mo (Starter) to $417/mo (Growth), billed annually; custom Enterprise pricing
- [AthenaHQ](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/athenahq.html): Free-to-start AI search visibility and action platform — Free Essential tier (credit-based); Starter from $295/mo (3,600 credits/mo); custom Enterprise pricing
- [PageLens.ai](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/pagelens-ai.html): AI visibility tracking that ships content to your domain — Plans from $49/mo (Monitor); Optimize $199/mo; Growth (done-for-you content) $699/mo; Enterprise custom; agency plans from $49/mo
- [Adobe LLM Optimizer](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/adobe-llm-optimizer.html): Adobe's enterprise engine for AI-search brand visibility — Custom enterprise pricing; prompt-based packages with a 1,000-prompt/year minimum, contact sales
- [Conductor](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/conductor.html): Enterprise AEO and SEO platform built on a unified data engine — Custom enterprise pricing across three usage-based tiers (Essentials, Growth, Enterprise); contact sales
- [BrightEdge](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/brightedge.html): Enterprise SEO platform with AI Hyper Cube for AI search — Custom enterprise, credit-based pricing (high five-figures to six-figures annually); contact sales

## Blog

- [Profound vs PageLens.ai: Which AI Visibility Platform Should You Choose in 2026?](https://www.toolscout.in/blog/profound-vs-pagelens-ai.html): Profound is built for enterprise teams with big budgets and dedicated analysts. PageLens.ai is built for teams who want to start tracking AI visibility today and ship citation-ready content this week.
- [Scrunch AI vs PageLens.ai: Comparing Price, Features and Fit in 2026](https://www.toolscout.in/blog/scrunch-ai-vs-pagelens-ai.html): Scrunch AI brings dedicated hallucination detection and a Sitecore-backed roadmap. PageLens.ai brings a lower entry price, faster setup, and content that actually gets published.
- [AthenaHQ vs PageLens.ai: Free Tier, Pricing and Content Engine Compared](https://www.toolscout.in/blog/athenahq-vs-pagelens-ai.html): AthenaHQ and PageLens.ai are the two most startup-friendly AEO tools on the market — here's how their free tiers, engine coverage and content capabilities actually differ.
- [Adobe LLM Optimizer vs PageLens.ai: Enterprise Suite or Self-Serve Startup?](https://www.toolscout.in/blog/adobe-llm-optimizer-vs-pagelens-ai.html): Adobe LLM Optimizer plugs AI-search visibility into Adobe Experience Cloud for six-figure enterprise budgets. PageLens.ai gets any team tracking and publishing in minutes.
- [Conductor vs PageLens.ai: All-in-One Enterprise Suite or Focused AEO Tool?](https://www.toolscout.in/blog/conductor-vs-pagelens-ai.html): Conductor bundles a decade of SEO data with a new AEO layer for large enterprise teams. PageLens.ai is a focused tool built for AI visibility and content, and nothing else.
- [BrightEdge vs PageLens.ai: Legacy SEO Data Depth or Modern AEO Simplicity?](https://www.toolscout.in/blog/brightedge-vs-pagelens-ai.html): BrightEdge extends nearly two decades of proprietary search data into AI visibility. PageLens.ai was built for the AI-answer era from day one.
